title: slf4j (logback) logs not getting forwarded to open-telemetry-collector
body:
I have created a spring-boot micro-service with spring-cloud-sleuth. I have also configured a open-telemetry-collector to forward the logs to datadog. The otel-collector is running in a docker container along with the micro-service. I have used logback-appender to forward the logs also to otel-collector along with traces. However, in datadog, I can only see traces and not logs. The logs printed are using the same traceId and spanId as that of trace. But due to some unknown reason, otel-collector is not exporting logs like it is exporting traces.

This issue can be reproduced using a POC with very few files and is uploaded at [https://github.com/reporter/distributed-tracing-spring](https://github.com/reporter/distributed-tracing-spring). The readme.md has the steps to run the application. You will need to enter a valid datadog API key in the .env (hidden) file.I will not be able to share the key since the key is specific to my organization.  
Please let me know if there is something else that I should specify along with these details.

I am using docker image otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.69.0 and Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Can you please check the collector metrics, to ensure it's actually receiving log data? You seem to be using the logging exporter as well: did you see anything printed in the console that would help confirm you received logs from your application?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Hey :)

not sure if i should open a new issue but I'm experiencing the same effect with a simple `otlp.http` receiver and a curl test.

I'm using the latest collector-contrib with this configuration:

```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:

exporters:
  logging:
    loglevel: "debug"

service:
  telemetry:
    logs:
      level: "debug"
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: []
      exporters: [logging]
``` 

When I make a post to the `/v1/logs` endpoint, the otel http server returns:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Tue, 24 Jan 2023 12:32:12 GMT
Content-Length: 21

{"partialSuccess":{}}
```

And when looking at the collector's logs, nothing happens.

> How to check the collector metrics? Can you please share the steps?

You can add config for the collector, like this:

```
service:
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      address: 0.0.0.0:8888
```

and go to `localhost:8888/metrics`

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Traces are not logs. You have your slf4j configured and it will print out log lines with the trace ID and span ID for the current request, but you'd have to write the logs to a file, which will then be read by the OpenTelemetry Collector. Or use a log appender that writes directly to the OTLP Logs port of the collector. Right now, your logs are being written to the console and are not being collected by anything.
